_comment: Annual rupees for the tax year. salary_gross = taxable salary before any exemption, EXCLUDING employer NPS (enter that separately). other_income_slab = interest, dividends, net rental income, slab-taxed gains (debt MFs, short-term foreign shares/RSU sales), freelance income. ltcg_equity = gross listed-equity LTCG before the annual exemption. ltcg_other = 12.5% LTCG (foreign shares held >24 months, gold, property). old_regime block is ignored for the new regime.
